item.title: [News] Four ways Google Research scientists have been using Empirical Research Assistance
item.description: Google Research scientists have been exploring four ways to leverage Empirical Research Assistance. This involves using AI to aid in academic research.

item.title: [News] Unlocking human ambition to drive business growth with AI
item.description: Microsoft has announced its plan to integrate AI-powered copilots and agents into various tools to drive business growth. This aims to unlock creativity, accelerate innovation and democratize intelligence by making AI more accessible to users.

item.title: [News] Microsoft Sovereign Private Cloud scales to thousands of nodes with Azure Local
item.description: Microsoft's Azure Local now supports deployments of up to thousands of servers within a single sovereign environment, enabling organizations to run larger workloads locally while maintaining control within their sovereign boundary.

item.title: [News] AWS nabs white hot gen AI media creation startup fal, becoming its preferred cloud provider
item.description: AWS has acquired fal, a Gen AI media creation platform, becoming its preferred cloud provider. This acquisition highlights the bottleneck of infrastructure requirements for real-time rendering of pixels in generative AI.

item.title: [News] The next phase of OpenAI’s Education for Countries
item.description: OpenAI has announced the next phase of Education for Countries, expanding AI adoption in schools through new partnerships, teacher training, and educational tools.
